scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.cpSync('voice-agent/prompts', 'dist/voice-agent/prompts', { recursive: true })"
